title: fxv publish command payload
description: Payload schema for the `fxv publish` command's JSON output.

published_revision.description: The revision the publish created, or null when the published branch already held the draft's tree, so there was nothing to publish.

files_published_count.description: Number of files the published revision adds, changes and deletes.

files_published.description: The files the published revision adds, changes and deletes, each with the draft change it published on the unpublished axis.

bytes_copied.description: The size of the content the published revision takes from the draft.

bytes_new.description: The bytes the publish staged: compressed, and only content the published repository did not already hold.
